items.title: Stop guessing auto scaling targets for TTS on Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Teams deploying custom text-to-speech models on Amazon SageMaker AI often guess at autoscaling thresholds, and a wrong guess either wastes GPU spend or breaches a latency SLO. This post deploys Kokoro-82M as a custom container and derives a measured autoscaling policy from two live-endpoint measurements, Q_max and T_total, instead of guesswork.
items.creator: Joseph Cottingham

items.title: How Rescale built an AI triage agent with Strands Agents and AI-DLC
items.summary: Rescale used the AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC) framework on AWS, with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock, to build an intelligent test-triage agent in weeks. Learn how AI-DLC structures AI-assisted development and how Rescale is scaling the practice across its engineering organization.
items.creator: Isha Doshi
